title: Legibility and Predictability of Robot Motion
one_sentence: 必须掌握 legibility 与 predictability 的区别；它是“机器人如何通过行为帮助人推断 intent”的基础。
problem: HRI 常把 predictable motion 与 legible intent 混为一谈；两者可能来自相反的 inference direction 并发生冲突。
method: 为 point robot、HERB 与 human reaching 制作 predictable/legible videos；432 US MTurk recruits，含 predictability ratings/path drawing 与 fully-between legibility stop-time/accuracy subexperiments；另 exploratory local n=5 HERB expectation study。
findings: predictable trajectory overall 更符合 expectation，F(1,310)=21.88,p<.001，但 character interaction 存在；HERB 不支持该 effect，human post-hoc adjusted p=.28 与正文叙述不一致。
legible trajectory 带来更早且更正确的 goal inference，F(1,241)=5.62,p=.019；HERB expectations variation 显示 cost model observer-dependent。
real_contribution: 建立 enduring conceptual/formal distinction，并以行为证据显示 motion optimized for goal inference need not be the expected trajectory。
biggest_weakness: video、hand-designed two-goal trajectories、无真实 collaboration/longitudinal adaptation；cost model 对 HERB misspecified，且 human post-hoc reporting 有不一致。
claim_boundary: 支持受控 goal-directed motion 中 legibility/predictability 区分；不覆盖 social meaning、gaze/gesture、history-based learning 或 convention formation。
why_researcher_should_care: 必须掌握 legibility 与 predictability 的区别；它是“机器人如何通过行为帮助人推断 intent”的基础。
